title: Xidoufen
lead:
{{Short description|Chinese soup dish}}
'''Xidoufen''' (稀豆粉) is a Chinese soup popular in [[Yunnan]] province that is made of boiled pea meal,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gokunming.com/en/blog/item/2663/getting_away_tengchong|title=Getting Away: Tengchong|publisher=GoKunming|author=Chris Horton|year=2012|access-date=2016-05-16|archive-date=2018-10-29|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181029091312/https://www.gokunming.com/en/blog/item/2663/getting_away_tengchong|url-status=dead}}</ref> often flavoured with crushed [[garlic]], [[ginger]], [[coriander]], [[spring onion]], dry [[Chili pepper|chilli]] flakes and [[Sichuan pepper]] oil. It is often eaten with [[deep fried]] ''[[youtiao]]'' or [[Bing (bread)|Chinese flatbreads]], particularly ''[[cong you bing]]''.
